memos.argument: NATCELL and CAR T cell products are cell-derived proteins/cell therapy materials. Heading 3002 covers immunological products and cell cultures, whether or not modified; Chapter 30 Note 2 defines immunological products as proteins directly involved in regulating immunological processes (antibodies, interleukins, interferons, growth factors, etc.), which fits T-cell/NK-cell directed proteins. Unmixed, not in measured doses -> 3002.13 (other, .90). If it is genetically modified cells (CAR T), 3002 'cell cultures, whether or not modified' also fits.
exclusions_against: Ch30 Note 1(ij): diagnostic reagents of heading 3822 are excluded from Ch30
Note 2 requires proteins directly involved in immune regulation; a mere research protein may not qualify
If put up in measured doses for therapy, 3004 (medicaments) would take precedence over 3002.15 per Section VI Note 2
No ruling found in cross_search (results irrelevant)

memos.argument: The product is described as a (Protein) product likely sold for research use; if it is a prepared laboratory reagent (e.g. for cell assays/staining/detection) heading 3822 covers prepared diagnostic or laboratory reagents, and Ch30 Note 1(ij) expressly sends diagnostic reagents there. Free general rate; 3822.19 other.
exclusions_against: Description says nothing of diagnostic/lab reagent use; 'CAR T cell' suggests therapeutic cell material, not reagent
3822 is residual to 3002/3006 ('other than those of heading 3006') and Note 2 to Ch38 does not give priority except for certified reference materials

memos.argument: As a protein substance not elsewhere specified, 3504 (peptones; other protein substances and derivatives n.e.s.) is the residual protein heading, with 3504.00.50.50 Other. Applies if the item is just a protein of no specific immunological function.
exclusions_against: Ch35 Note 1(b): excludes blood fractions, medicaments or other products of chapter 30
Heading is 'not elsewhere specified'; immunological proteins fall in 3002 under Ch30 Note 2
Cells/cell cultures are not protein substances
Duty 4% vs Free elsewhere; no ruling support
